About this range

Small, light and endlessly reorderable, wine stoppers and pourers are how you build a repeat-order account. This range runs from a 0.55-cent-class universal pourer through silicone vacuum stoppers with a 31-day freshness dial, stainless vacuum stoppers, and the champagne sipper family — including electroplated and branded versions that clients order as event favours and gift-with-purchase items. Custom logo moulding is available on the highest-volume shapes.

Material focus

ABS, silicone, TPR, acrylic, stainless steel

Wine Stoppers &amp; Pourers — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Wine Stoppers & Pourers range include?

This range holds 25 items, specified in ABS, silicone, TPR, acrylic and stainless steel. Orders come most often from promotional distributors, wineries and tasting rooms and restaurants and hotels. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

Which wine stoppers & pourers can be branded?

Branding is evaluated against the specific opener, stopper, preserver or aerator SKU. The feasible logo method depends on the material, logo area, artwork, quantity and required packaging.

Logo decoration guide

Can wine stoppers & pourers be packed into a custom gift set?

Yes, subject to confirmation of each item, the insert layout, outer box, logo treatment, quantity and shipping protection. Submit the full set composition rather than requesting a quotation for individual items only.

Barware gift sets

How do I compare wine stoppers & pourers products?

Compare the stated components, compatible bottle format, intended use, care instructions and verified performance documentation. We do not publish preservation claims that are not supported by the selected SKU records.

Wine stoppers and pourers

Are the electric openers rechargeable or battery operated?

Both configurations exist in the range. The power source, charging method, plug standard and set contents are stated on the selected SKU page and confirmed in the quotation, because they change the price and the shipping documentation.
